en.text: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

zhSimplified.text: 此后，我观看，见天上有门开了。我初次听见好像吹号的声音，对我说：「你上到这里来，我要将以后必成的事指示你。」

zhTraditional.text: 此後，我觀看，見天上有門開了。我初次聽見好像吹號的聲音，對我說：「你上到這裏來，我要將以後必成的事指示你。」

en.text: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

zhSimplified.text: 我立刻被圣灵感动，见有一个宝座安置在天上，又有一位坐在宝座上。

zhTraditional.text: 我立刻被聖靈感動，見有一個寶座安置在天上，又有一位坐在寶座上。

en.text: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

zhSimplified.text: 看那坐着的，好像碧玉和红宝石；又有虹围着宝座，好像绿宝石。

zhTraditional.text: 看那坐着的，好像碧玉和紅寶石；又有虹圍着寶座，好像綠寶石。

en.text: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

zhSimplified.text: 宝座的周围又有二十四个座位；其上坐着二十四位长老，身穿白衣，头上戴着金冠冕。

zhTraditional.text: 寶座的周圍又有二十四個座位；其上坐着二十四位長老，身穿白衣，頭上戴着金冠冕。

en.text: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

zhSimplified.text: 有闪电、声音、雷轰从宝座中发出；又有七盏火灯在宝座前点着；这七灯就是 神的七灵。

zhTraditional.text: 有閃電、聲音、雷轟從寶座中發出；又有七盞火燈在寶座前點着；這七燈就是上帝的七靈。

en.text: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

zhSimplified.text: 宝座前好像一个玻璃海，如同水晶。

zhTraditional.text: 寶座前好像一個玻璃海，如同水晶。

en.text: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

zhSimplified.text: 第一个活物像狮子，第二个像牛犊，第三个脸面像人，第四个像飞鹰。

zhTraditional.text: 第一個活物像獅子，第二個像牛犢，第三個臉面像人，第四個像飛鷹。

en.text: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

footnotes.text: 4:8 Hodges/Farstad MT reads “holy” 9 times instead of 3.

zhSimplified.text: 四活物各有六个翅膀，遍体内外都满了眼睛。他们昼夜不住地说： 圣哉！圣哉！圣哉！ 主 神是昔在、今在、 以后永在的全能者。

zhTraditional.text: 四活物各有六個翅膀，遍體內外都滿了眼睛。他們晝夜不住地說： 聖哉！聖哉！聖哉！ 主上帝是昔在、今在、 以後永在的全能者。

en.text: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

zhSimplified.text: 每逢四活物将荣耀、尊贵、感谢归给那坐在宝座上、活到永永远远者的时候，

zhTraditional.text: 每逢四活物將榮耀、尊貴、感謝歸給那坐在寶座上、活到永永遠遠者的時候，

en.text: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 那二十四位长老就俯伏在坐宝座的面前敬拜那活到永永远远的，又把他们的冠冕放在宝座前，说：

zhTraditional.text: 那二十四位長老就俯伏在坐寶座的面前敬拜那活到永永遠遠的，又把他們的冠冕放在寶座前，說：

en.text: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”

footnotes.text: 4:11 TR omits “and God, the Holy One,”

zhSimplified.text: 我们的主，我们的 神， 你是配得荣耀、尊贵、权柄的； 因为你创造了万物， 并且万物是因你的旨意被创造而有的。

zhTraditional.text: 我們的主，我們的上帝， 你是配得榮耀、尊貴、權柄的； 因為你創造了萬物， 並且萬物是因你的旨意被創造而有的。
